en: Imposing. Sinister. Sprawling. Red. All these adjectives fit this place.
That's a LOT of dead people.
Yes, the situation is positively dire but at least the sky is gorgeous!
Thousands of humans pulled from their eternal slumber to fuel an unholy ritual. Death must be stopped!
This site has been at the center of funeral rites for centuries. Now, it serves as a catalyst for the return of pure evil.
The tension is so high, you can almost touch it. Nobody's welcome here.
One needs an iron will when facing the Castle Master's imperious presence.
Wooden stake: check. Garlic : at the ready. Silver: the banker said no.
Ignoring for a moment the horrors fought on the way there and the problematic personality of its owner, this part of the Castle is magnificient!
This room of the Castle has had its fair share of epic fights between Good and Evil.
Passage to the Promenade of the Condemned
Passage to the Morass of the Banished
Passage to the Stilt Village and the Slumbering Sanctuary
Passage to the Stilt Village and the Graveyard
Passage to the High Peak Castle and the Derelict Distillery
Passage to the Stilt Village, the Slumbering Sanctuary and the Graveyard
This part of the Castle don't look familiar at all. How did Richter get there?
Life in Richter's shoes is basically the same. You just have to be sure before you jump.
In a world of darkness, the people are defended by one vampire-hunting clan member: Richter Belmont who fights Dracula's plan to control the world. This is his story. DUN DUN!
"Tom's Place"
"Prisoner and Doctor of Mushroomology"
Abandoned ages ago.
Oh.
Actually, a family of rats seems to call the place home these days.
The devious little fellow made a passage for himself through the wall...
Seems to be where the Mushroomologist stashed the profits from his little business.
A variety of differently shaped mushrooms are proliferating in these jars.
By the looks of them, they should have some interesting psychotropic properties.
Good ol' Doctor Tom here must have been supplying the whole prison.
All kinds of mushrooms have been carefully ground down into fine multicolored powders.
Pretty sure they weren’t using these to flavor the soup.
I don't understand a thing...
But the King is quite dead...
Why didn't anything change!?
WHAT DOES IT MEAN!?
...What does it mean?
Guess he wanted to choose the time of his death.
He's holding a faded flower between his fingers.
A moment of silence...
Nah! I've got better things to do!
A whole bunch of plants that seem to have been a bit underwatered recently.
Looks like this guy loved flowers.
There's a label on the pot:
"Do not water after midnight!"
That thing planted there looks less like a flower than an experiment gone horribly wrong.
There are seeds on the window ledge.
That must be where he got his supply from.
All the fabric from the bed seems to have been torn up and used elsewhere.
This campfire was abandoned by an earlier visitor...
I'm sure it couldn't hurt to take a little rest.
Hmm. Something's changed.
Words written on the wall:
"GIT GUD"
Must be some sort of incantation.
A guy in armor, been dead for a while.
Oh. It's... "you".
Looks like I'm on the right side of the door for once!
HA HA HA!
Damn, they didn't mess around...
No answer.
Been abandoned here for some time.
Someone's groaning on the other side.
Get out of here, you freak!
Leave me alone!
There's water running through my cell!
I think something in the water touched my leg!
HELP!!
Whole lot of prisoners piled up here.
Some of them have been here for a very long time.
One of them is holding on to something...
It's the King’s coat of arms.
That's one way of dealing with the prison overpopulation problem.
This prisoner's stay was cut short.
Can’t say whether it's a man or a woman.
The crows already worked this one over pretty good.
"By order of the King, all persons presenting behavioral disorders or noticeable deteriorations in their appearance..."
"... shall be imprisoned, and hanged by the neck until dead."
"... (if the prison doctor confirms the diagnosis of Infection)."
Glad they added that. For a second there, I really thought we were talking about genocide.
A young woman.
"Prisoner 6541"
She's clutching something in her fist.
A man, about forty years old.
Can't really be sure.
"Suspected infection"
This one was either a dwarf, or she was no more than 10 or 12 years old.
Let's just say she was a dwarf.
It was supposed to burn, but a few things seem to have survived.
Oh, interesting.
A woman who opted for the fast method.
Strange, she doesn't seem to be infected.
Must be her last words.
